items.title: QwenLM/Qwen3-Omni
items.raw_content: Qwen3-omni is a natively end-to-end, omni-modal LLM developed by the Qwen team at Alibaba Cloud, capable of understanding text, audio, images, and video, as well as generating speech in real time.  [Lang: Jupyter Notebook]

items.title: Asciinema CLI 3.0 rewritten in Rust, adds live streaming, upgrades file format
items.raw_content: This is a complete rewrite of asciinema in Rust, upgrading the recording file format, introducing terminal live streaming, and bringing numerous improvements across the board. In this post, I’ll go over the highlights of the release. For a deeper overview of new features and improvements, see the release notes and the detailed changelog .

items.summary: Asciinema CLI 3.0 is a complete Rust rewrite that upgrades the recording file format, adds terminal live streaming and includes numerous other improvements.

items.summary: According to a Mastodon post citing netzpolitik.org, Germany's position on the EU's Chat Control proposal has reverted to undecided; despite concerns about breaking end-to-end encryption, it did not take a definitive stance at the September 12 LEWP meeting.

items.title: AI tools are making the world look weird

items.summary: STRAT7 writes that large language models reflect WEIRD — Western, educated, industrialised, rich and democratic — perspectives, and examines the implications of that bias for researchers operating in global markets.

items.title_zh: surajverma/homehub：自托管的家庭实用工具

items.title_zh: souvenp/lx-netease-music-mobile：网易云音乐移动端项目
items.summary: A TypeScript repository named lx-netease-music-mobile, apparently a mobile client related to NetEase Music.

items.title: MoonTechLab/Selene
items.title_zh: MoonTechLab/Selene：MoonTV 多平台客户端
items.summary: A client for the MoonTV v100 / Helios backend that runs on iOS, Android, macOS and Windows, with optimizations for each platform.

items.title: p-e-w/heretic
items.title_zh: p-e-w/heretic：自动移除语言模型审查
items.summary: Heretic is a Python project that performs fully automatic censorship removal for language models.

items.title: A comparison of pipelines for the translation of a low resource language based on transformers
items.title_zh: 基于 Transformer 的低资源语言翻译流程比较
items.summary: The study compares three transformer-based pipelines for French-to-Bambara translation and finds the simplest one achieves the best accuracy, with 10% BLEU and 21% chrF on the Bayelemagaba dataset.

items.title: Estimating Semantic Alphabet Size for LLM Uncertainty Quantification
items.title_zh: 为 LLM 不确定性量化估计语义字母表大小
items.summary: The authors revisit the discrete semantic entropy estimator, show that it underestimates true semantic entropy, and propose a modified semantic alphabet size estimator that improves estimation and flags incorrect LLM responses while remaining interpretable.

items.title: SmolRGPT: Efficient Spatial Reasoning for Warehouse Environments with 600M Parameters
items.title_zh: SmolRGPT：面向仓储环境的 6 亿参数高效空间推理模型
items.summary: SmolRGPT is a compact 600M-parameter vision-language model that combines RGB and depth cues for region-level spatial reasoning, using a three-stage curriculum. It matches or exceeds larger models on warehouse spatial reasoning benchmarks.

items.title: DISCO: Disentangled Communication Steering for Large Language Models
items.title_zh: DISCO：面向大语言模型的解耦通信引导
items.summary: The paper proposes DISCO, which injects steering vectors directly into query and value representation spaces inside attention heads; on LLaMA 3.1 8B and Gemma 2 9B it reports steering efficacy up to 19.1% higher than the runner-up baseline.

items.title: Task-Oriented Communications for 3D Scene Representation: Balancing Timeliness and Fidelity
items.title_zh: 面向 3D 场景表示的任务导向通信：平衡时效性与保真度
items.summary: The paper studies a wireless system in which camera-equipped mobile robots send images to an edge server for 3D scene representation, and proposes a contextual-bandit PPO framework using Age of Information and semantic information to balance freshness and fidelity.

items.title: Computational Analysis of Conversation Dynamics through Participant Responsivity
items.title_zh: 通过参与者响应性计算分析对话动态
items.summary: The authors quantify conversational responsivity using semantic similarity and LLM-based relation detection against human annotations, then derive conversation-level metrics that characterize different dialogue structures.
